title.value: Adaptive patch foraging in deep reinforcement learning agents
title.justification: The title accurately represents the core study of the paper, which investigates reinforcement learning agents' behavior in patch foraging tasks.
title.quote: Title of the paper: Adaptive patch foraging in deep reinforcement learning agents

extractions.description: This paper studies the behavior of deep reinforcement learning agents in ecological patch foraging tasks. It explores how these agents can learn optimal foraging behavior, similar to biological foragers, within a simulated environment. The research connects internal dynamics of AI agents to neural recordings from foraging animals, providing insights into both artificial and biological intelligence systems.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The study explicitly focuses on ecological patch foraging, an important aspect of biological foraging behavior, and explores how AI models can mimic such ecological behaviors. This directly relates to ecological sustainable development by drawing parallels between artificial and natural systems.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Here, we investigate deep reinforcement learning agents in an ecological patch foraging task.

primary_category.justification: The primary focus of the research is on simulating ecological foraging behaviors, which align with the protection and understanding of natural systems.
primary_category.quote: The first investigation of deep recurrent reinforcement learning agents in a complex ecological patch foraging task;

secondary_categories.justification: The research offers models that can improve the understanding of ecological behaviors and dynamics, aiding in broader climate science efforts.
secondary_categories.quote: This paper contributes a model with which biological and artificial intelligence researchers may further understand patch foraging — a fundamental decision problem that strongly guided the evolution of biological intelligence.

primary_sub_category.justification: The study focuses on ecological patterns and behaviors, specifically relating to biodiversity in terms of foraging strategies.
primary_sub_category.quote: Adaptive patch foraging is a crucial behavioral pattern in many biological species, and understanding it can contribute to biodiversity research.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: By providing insights into ecological behaviors and their simulations, this research indirectly supports climate modeling efforts.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Foraging as an evidence accumulation process.

applications.justification: The research applies deep reinforcement learning to model ecological foraging, creating scenarios that replicate natural behaviors.
applications.quote: The first investigation of deep recurrent reinforcement learning agents in a complex ecological patch foraging task

new_primary_category.justification: The existing categories adequately capture the paper's focus on natural systems protection and biodiversity.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The existing sub-categories, especially 'Biodiversity', fit the paper's scope.
